question: Is our webhook still disabled? If so, please turn it back on.

model.source: recorded from claude-opus-5-5 through the anthropic provider

replies.text: Yes, webhook wh_31c9 (https://hooks.kitewood.example/fernway) is still disabled. Fernway turned it off on 2026-09-30 at 15:58 UTC after 50 failures in a row, and the last one was a timeout after 10 seconds [help:webhooks@2#2]. I can't turn it back on because my tools can only view webhooks, not change them. Webhooks are managed by Admins under Settings → Integrations → Webhooks, so you'll need to ask a workspace Admin, such as Ada (u_ada), who created it [help:webhooks@2#0]. Before it's turned back on, the endpoint needs to be fixed so it sends a 2xx response within 10 seconds, or it will fail again [help:webhooks@2#2]. The help articles don't say how to re-enable a disabled webhook, so if your Admin can't find the option, contact support@fernway.example.
